desc: The typed state schema: the context object every expression evaluates against. Types use a compact notation: ? = nullable, [] = list of, {} = record, enum values inline or referenced to vocabulary.json. Fields marked input:true are world-facts the engine cannot derive — they arrive with events (like vote tallies) and are listed in gaps.json as judgment/world inputs.

Frame.applied_to: ?frame-id — the frame this motion operates on [6:6(1)]; null for privileged motions [6:11]
Frame.adheres_to: ?frame-id — adherence per [10:35]; diverges from applied_to for non-adhering incidentals and privileged frames
Frame.effective_rank: number — position in precedence.json rank_order, positionally modified per engine.json effective_rank

Question.original_main: boolean — original main motion vs incidental main [10:3-7]

purpose_class.desc: content classification recorded at making (e.g. a suspend-rules touching priority of business [18:4(1)])

Question.reconsider_hold: ?{made_by, seconded_by, made_at, called_up: boolean, enter_minutes: boolean}
Question.election_pending: boolean — the question is a pending election [46:1]
Question.scheduled_item: ?ScheduledItem — the order-of-the-day record through which this question came (or is due to come) before the assembly [41:40-57]

independent_subject_series.desc: a series of independent resolutions on different subjects offered by one motion; single-member demand splits [27:10]

nonconforming_amendment_series.desc: an amendment series not conforming to a pattern; single-member demand splits [27:11]

reconsider_excluded.desc: the vote falls under a 37:9(2) exclusion (partly executed, notified contract, etc.)

Vote.present_count_at_affirmative: ?number — counted by the chair immediately after the affirmative when the threshold basis is members-present, before attendance can change [44:9(a)]
Vote.negative_called: boolean — the negative votes have been cast/called; opens the division window [29:4(1)]
Vote.ballots_collected: boolean — ballot method only: the tellers have collected the ballots; opens the adjourn-during-ballot window [21:6(1)]
Vote.polls_closed: boolean — all have presumably voted [45:6]; enables announce-result

excluded_member_votes.desc: members denied the right to vote or to attend while this vote was taken [23:7]

improper_votes.desc: votes cast in violation of fundamental principle — nonmembers, absentees, multiple votes by one member [23:8]

prevailing_members.desc: recorded only for roll-call; otherwise established by member assertion via adjudication (prevailing-side-claim)

Order.coverage: enum static|extends-to-subsequent-debatables — limiting orders (previous-question excepted) also cover debatable subsidiaries, reconsiders, and debatable appeals that become pending later while in force; extending orders cover only the frames ordered [15:8]. Both cover reconsiderations of affected questions before, not after, exhaustion [15:18]
Order.closure: enum deadline|budget — close-at-hour orders eat time lost to interruptions (tabled time counts against the clock); duration/budget orders do not (interruption time does not diminish the allowance) [15:16]

Member.roles: [role id] — chair/secretary global; maker/seconder/reporting-member bound per-question (protocol.json roles NOTE)

in_good_standing.desc: basic rights removable only by discipline [25:11, 61]

TimerInstance.open: boolean — evaluated from the timer definition's expires expression

context.config: the council configuration (council.json): {configuration: id, <parameter assignments>} — the axes instantiating this body; consulted by expressions as ["ctx", "config", <param>]. The generic files state ordinary-society values; overlays patch at load.

assembly.quorum: number — computed from config.quorum_basis [40:2: present / attendees / registered-delegates-majority / enrolled-majority / bylaws-specified]

term_boundary_before_next_session.desc: a specified portion of membership ends its term before the next regular session [21:7(b-c)]

context.contexts: [PendingStack] — the context stack (engine.json context_stack); last = active; frozen whole by recess/adjournment [8:7, 21:7(a)]
context.orders: [Order] — debate-limiting orders in force; owned by rules state, read by guard/no-order-precluding, expired by timer/order-exhaustion (lifecycle)
context.vote_in_progress: ?Vote — guard/voting-in-progress reads non-null and polls open [45:6]

history.business_transacted_since: {marker -> boolean} — e.g. since a tabling, for take-from-table's precondition [34:2(2)]. DERIVED: computable as any-qualifying-event-after-the-marker over history.events; an engine should derive rather than maintain it (a maintained duplicate of the log can silently diverge)
